name: Water — Still Pool (Live GPU)
description: GPU MLS-MPM still pool in the Water — Dam Break basin: a half-metre pool that should settle and stay still. The solver is one group, Live Matter: the domain sets the lattice, walls, gravity and clock; the fill seeds points; Point State repeats Clear Grid, Points To Grid, Grid Update and Grid To Points once per substep; at each tick's first substep Sort Into Blocks orders the points by grid block so Points To Grid adds each block in fast memory; Tick Stats checks each tick; Frame publishes the particles. The group flattens to the same graph as its wired atoms. Particles are drawn as small spheres until the liquid surface lands.
